# rwbjee

> rwbjee is a free, community-built companion website for WBJEE aspirants in West Bengal, India. It is not affiliated with WBJEEB; official announcements and authoritative information come from https://wbjeeb.nic.in/.

The site helps students evaluate WBJEE admission options using historical cutoff data, a college predictor, college profiles, exam timeline information, blog content, and community links.

Important notes:

- Treat predictor output as guidance based on historical trends, not as a guarantee of admission.
- The site currently covers cutoff history from 2021 through 2025.
- The main audience is WBJEE aspirants, parents, and counselors comparing engineering and pharmacy colleges in West Bengal.
- Core public content is available on the main website; operational details such as admin routes are not intended for general end users.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.rwbjee.com/): Overview of the product, featured colleges, timeline highlights, FAQs, and community entry points.
- [College Predictor](https://www.rwbjee.com/predictor): Predict likely colleges and branches from WBJEE rank using historical cutoff trends.
- [Cutoff Finder](https://www.rwbjee.com/cutoffs): Search opening and closing ranks by college, program, year, category, round, and seat type.
- [College Directory](https://www.rwbjee.com/colleges): Browse WBJEE-participating colleges.
- [Timeline](https://www.rwbjee.com/timeline): Important WBJEE schedule and event information for the current exam cycle.
- [Blog](https://www.rwbjee.com/blog): Articles, guides, announcements, and student-focused resources.
- [Socials](https://www.rwbjee.com/socials): Reddit and Discord community links.
- [FAQ](https://www.rwbjee.com/faq): Common questions about the site, predictor, and WBJEE usage context.

## Data And APIs

- [Cutoffs dataset](https://www.rwbjee.com/cutoffs): Primary public interface for historical cutoff exploration.
- [Predictor filter API](https://www.rwbjee.com/api/predictor/filter): Backend endpoint used by the predictor tool.
- [Predictor metadata API](https://www.rwbjee.com/api/predictor/metadata): Metadata endpoint used to support predictor filters and UI state.
- [Cutoff search API](https://www.rwbjee.com/api/v1/cutoffs/search): Public API route for cutoff search queries.
- [Timeline API](https://www.rwbjee.com/api/v1/timeline): Public API route for timeline events.

## College Content

- [College listing](https://www.rwbjee.com/colleges): Entry point for all college profiles.
- [College profile pages](https://www.rwbjee.com/colleges): Individual college pages include available programs, location, and supporting details when present.
- [Cutoff explorer](https://www.rwbjee.com/cutoffs): Best source for historical opening and closing ranks across colleges and programs.

## Community

- [r/wbjee subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/wbjee/): Community discussions and student Q&A.
- [Discord server](https://discord.gg/pTTKPYryDp): Real-time community chat and support.
- [Developer profile](https://www.reddit.com/user/rizzz6/): Maintainer profile referenced by the site.
